about_the_game:
DARKZAN ARENA: ASCENSION – ORDER HAS ARRIVED!

The forces of chaos have shaken the arena, but now, a new presence takes control. Urdeen, the God of Order, manifests his will, shaping the conflicts with relentless logic. He brings neither mercy nor punishment—only absolute balance.

Those who fight must adapt to the new rules now governing the battlefield. The Arena has changed... will you rise above order?

⚔️ A NEW ERA BEGINS!

With Darkzan Arena: Ascension, new challenges and possibilities unfold for all warriors! This FREE expansion adds even more depth to combat with new items, enemies, and mechanics that will transform your Arena experience!

🔥 WHAT'S NEW?

✅ +50 New Items – Weapons, armor, and artifacts infused with the power of order!
✅ +15 New Enemies – Creatures that follow Urdeen’s laws, bringing new threats and attack patterns!
✅ New Challenges & Strategies – The logic of battle has shifted, requiring new approaches to survive!

Urdeen's influence is growing... can chaos endure?

🔥 The fate of the Arena is in your hands! 🔥
